volunteerExperiences.description: I worked 2 weeks in the summer of 2015, volunteering as a music minister and preteen moderator. As music minister one week, I controlled the music for mass and daily events. At mass, I would play the music live on the guitar. As a preteen moderator one week, I worked with preteens and helped them through daily lessons of Communication, Affirmation, Forgiveness, and Commitment. For this, I worked with 2 other staff members as leaders for these preteens.

projects.title: Optical Guitar Pickup
projects.description: Working off of a previous Senior Design project at RIT, myself and 2 others are working on a design for an optical guitar pickip. Our goal is to design multiple sensor board configurations to track the guitar string's frequency. This project was given to us through Dr. Dorin Patru.
